2. back-averaged EEG for a Bereitschaftspotential before the movements: Bereitschaftspotential present before the jerks
3. somatosensory evoked potentials (giant SEP, C-reflex): normal, no giant SEP and no C-reflex - excludes cortical reflex myoclonus
4. jerk latency and burst-duration measurement: long and VARIABLE latency with a long duration of muscle contraction - the pattern of voluntary movement, not of cortical myoclonus
